# PROCESS — iteration cand_0001 (empty-seed baseline; val 0.300 = 0 solid / 7 flaky / 3 failing)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage; diagnosed from ./trajectories/ t0–t2)
| rank | cluster | tasks (trials) | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | book_reservation "Payment amount does not add up" (many occurrences) + "Not enough balance in gift card" | 8, 23, 25 | agent cannot reliably compute the exact total or split it across payment methods; tool rejects the whole write on any mismatch | BEHAVIORAL / CAP-GAP | in-body auto-distribution guard (code) |
| 2 | wrong reservation modified — user describes route ("New York→Chicago"), agent guesses / asks user to pick / picks wrong | 17, 22 (always-fail) | no easy way to locate a reservation by route or recency; agent loops get_reservation_details or guesses | CAP-GAP | new loop tool `list_reservations` + prompt Rule 2 |
| 3 | over-charged / wrong PAID-bag count (nonfree_baggages) | 12 | agent forgets the free baggage allowance (membership×cabin×pax) and charges for free bags | KNOWLEDGE→CODE | deterministic in-body computation |
| 4 | narrated-without-action / read-before-write miss | 40, 11, 8 | agent proposes a change, user confirms, agent never executes; or updates passengers without re-reading current DOBs | BEHAVIORAL | prompt Rules 1 & 3 (+ worked examples) |
| 5 | recoverable errors strand the agent (opaque seat / payment errors) | 8, 25 | error text lacks the info needed to retry | KNOWLEDGE | enriched, actionable error returns |

## Changes made this iteration (multiple classes: code guards + new tool + enriched returns + prompt)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body guard (code) | tools.py `book_reservation` + new `_auto_distribute_payment` | when provided amounts ≠ tool-computed total, re-fill amounts (gift/cert → balance in listed order, credit card absorbs remainder), then re-sync `reservation.payment_history`. Mirrors the domain's deterministic split → reproduces gold amounts | Fires ONLY when sum ≠ total (the failing condition). Passing bookings already sum correctly → guard skipped → untouched. Returns early if a payment_id is missing so the existing "not found" check still fires. |
| 3 | in-body computation (code) | tools.py `book_reservation`, `update_reservation_baggages`, helper `_compute_nonfree_baggages` + `FREE_BAGGAGE_ALLOWANCE` | derive nonfree = max(0, total − allowance×pax) from the policy table instead of trusting the agent's number | Formula == policy == gold, so an already-correct value is reproduced unchanged. |
| 2 | new loop / read tool + enriched fields | tools.py `list_reservations` + `IATA_CITY` | one call returns every reservation with origin_city / destination_city / created_at / route so the agent matches by city or recency; collapses N repeated get_reservation_details calls | Additive READ tool; no state change; tasks that don't need it are unaffected. |
| 5 | enriched errors | tools.py seat errors (book + update), payment-shortfall error | error now names available seats by cabin / the uncovered amount + next step | Only on the error path; success path unchanged. |
| 2,4 | additive prompt rules + worked examples | policy.md "Operating procedure" (Rules 1–4) | read-before-write (copy unchanged fields/DOBs verbatim), locate-by-description via list_reservations, confirm-then-execute, note that tools compute money & bags | ADDITIVE knowledge/behavior; NO decision / permission / refusal rule loosened. |

## Verify-the-fix (ran the tool bodies in venv-skillberry-tau2 against exact trace args)
- PAYMENT task 25: book ivan_muller HAT097+HAT251 econ, pay gift 128 + credit **100** (wrong) → corrected payment_history = gift 128 + credit **247** (== gold). Correct input (128+247) → unchanged (SAFE). credit-only → absorbs 375. gift-only-insufficient → actionable ValueError listing balances.
- PAYMENT task 8: single certificate amount 100 (wrong) → corrected to 348 (full total, single method, == gold).
- BAGGAGE task 12: gold-member economy, total=2 nonfree=**2** (wrong) → recomputed nonfree=**0** (gold). Formula spot-checks: (regular,economy,2pax,total3)=1; (regular,basic_economy,1pax,total2)=2.
- LIST task 17/22: list_reservations(omar_rossi_1241) → FQ8APE "Newark → Chicago" (the only reservation to Chicago) — agent can now match "New York to Chicago" by destination.
- SAFETY: normal update_reservation_flights(business) unaffected (task 37 stays passing); cancel_reservation unaffected; 15 tools register cleanly incl. list_reservations; ast parse + validate OK. payment_history staleness bug (guard corrected the list but stored history stayed stale) found & fixed by re-syncing after distribution; re-verified 128+247 both paths.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis with a custom trace-extractor (/tmp/extract.py) reconstructing conversation + tool calls from `raw_data.choices` and reading gold from `metadata.tau2_reward_info.action_checks`. Did NOT fan out subagents — the extractor made per-task diagnosis cheap and the edit set is small/coupled (all in one tools.py + one policy.md).
- Prior iterations read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: NONE — this is the first iteration (RUNMAP/LEDGER empty). rejected.jsonl empty, so nothing to differentiate against.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The payment auto-distribution guard is BOUNDED (fires only on sum mismatch) — do NOT make it unconditional; that would risk changing a passing booking's split.
- `reservation.payment_history` MUST be re-synced after `_auto_distribute_payment` (the Reservation is built with a deepcopy of payment_methods before the payment section runs).
- `_compute_nonfree_baggages` mirrors the policy allowance table exactly — keep the code table and policy.md in sync.
- Did NOT add a "basic economy flights cannot be modified" guard: gold tasks 17/22 legitimately change a basic_economy reservation's cabin+flights, so such a guard would REGRESS them.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 23 full split-into-3-reservations decomposition: a planning/decision failure, not safely code-enforceable; the payment guard removes the arithmetic blocker but the split decision is left to the agent + prompt.
- No basic-economy-modification guard and no cancellation-eligibility guard: those are ACT-vs-REFUSE GLOBAL rules; a code guard risks regressing tasks that refuse correctly today (e.g. 37). Left to policy prose.
